scenarios.name: Transfer multiple selected commands between customization lists

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Ribbon customization dialog shows an empty Part Tools custom panel
All Commands lists "2D Sketches" immediately before "3D Annotations"
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list
the user presses Shift+Down
both commands are selected in the available list
the user clicks the right transfer button
the custom panel list contains "2D Sketches" followed by "3D Annotations"
neither command remains in the available list
the target indicates a pending change
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list
the user presses Shift+Down
the user clicks the left transfer button
the custom panel list is empty
both commands return to the available list
the target still indicates a pending change
the user clicks Cancel
the customization dialog closes
no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
